title: Methodology for Calculating the Damaged Surface and Its Relationship with Power Loss in Photovoltaic Modules by Electroluminescence Inspection for Corrective Maintenance
mechanism: Method following IEC TS 60904-13: the per-cell percentage of Type-C crack area is mapped to module power loss; the most damaged cell dominates module performance.
adaptation: Per-cell severity = predicted inactive fraction. Module-level E1 severity = max over cells, not the mean. Use for the E1 module-level severity score (67 modules).
min_experiment: Benchmark-only: compute max-cell inactive band per E1 module from GT and predictions; report weighted kappa per model.
evidence: R: one polycrystalline module, repeated impacts, I-V after each; cell-level estimates beat substring or module level; applied to 4 field modules.

alt_notes.adaptation: Our predicted inactive masks give the per-cell inactive area fraction directly; use to define a power-loss band metric for severity post-evaluation.
alt_notes.min_experiment: No training: compute inactive-area fraction from GT and predictions on test / E1, report band agreement (e.g. 0, <5%, 5 to 20%, >20%).
